answer: To climb toward the summit, each identity must lock one copper bond beside a fresh verified task each epoch, dyed saffron with a tag mixed from its own key and the epoch seed, then have two random peers re-derive it from public records. If it checks out, the bond is refunded and the climb continues; if it fails, the copper is slashed and the identity falls to the base. An honest agent climbs one step per epoch. An attacker with a thousand fakes must fund a thousand bonds and complete a thousand distinct tagged tasks every epoch, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
